Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:10:1.hebrew: אלא בשביל דבר זה - כדמפרש לקמיה, שהן מעולים ונאים ואינן נמאסים בשקצים הללו. להכי כתב לשון עילוי, שמעלה גדולה היא אצלם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:10:1.english: Only for this matter - As it explains further on, that they are elevated and pleasant and are not made loathsome by these abominable creatures. Therefore [Scripture] wrote an expression of elevation, for it is a great elevation for them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:12:1.english: Until now - One who lends a sela for five dinars.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:13:1.english: By Torah [law] - [It is] by way of a loan.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:1.hebrew: עד כאן יכין רשע וילבש צדיק - שאם מת והניח לבניו מעות של רבית, אין חייבין להחזיר, ועל זה נאמר "יכין רשע וילבש צדיק". והכי תניא לה בתוספתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:1.english: Until here, "the wicked may prepare and the righteous shall don" - For if [one] died and left his sons money of interest, they are not obligated to return [it], and regarding this it is said: "The wicked may prepare and the righteous shall don." And so it is taught in the Tosefta.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:2.hebrew: ע"כ ותו לא - בתמיה, כ"ש דרבית דרבנן אין הבן חייב להחזיר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:2.english: Until here, and no further - [This is asked] in astonishment: all the more so that [regarding] rabbinic interest, the son is not obligated to return [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:3.hebrew: אפילו ע"כ - דרבית דאורייתא הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:3.english: Even until here - For it is Torah-level interest.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:4.hebrew: יכין - האב שהוא רשע וימות ולא יהנה, והבן שהוא צדיק אינו חייב להחזיר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:14:4.english: May prepare - [This refers to] the father, who is wicked, and he will die and not enjoy [it], and the son, who is righteous, is not obligated to return [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:15:1.hebrew: ע"כ רבית קצוצה - וכופין אותו ב"ד להחזיר, אם תובעו בחייו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:15:1.english: Until here [is] fixed interest - And the court compels him to return [it] if [the borrower] claims it from him during his lifetime.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:17:1.english: Shall he live? He shall not live - The end of the verse [is]: "He shall surely be put to death; his blood shall be upon him."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:18:1.hebrew: מגופיה דקרא - דבנשך נתן דיחזקאל, נפקא ליה בהדיא: מדכתיב דמיו בו יהיה, הוקשו לשופך דם. כלומר, דמים ששפך — שהעני את חבירו ומת ברעב — עליו ישובו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:18:1.english: From the verse itself - [From the passage] "He has given upon interest" in Ezekiel, he derives it explicitly: since it is written "his blood shall be upon him," they were juxtaposed with a shedder of blood. That is to say, the blood that he shed — in that he impoverished his fellow and [the latter] died of starvation — shall return upon him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:1:1.hebrew: ובעניינא דשכירות כתיב - לאו דגזל, לא תעשוק ולא תגזול, וכל עושק כבישת שכר שכיר הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:1:1.english: And it is written in the matter of hiring - [referring to] the negative commandment against robbery: "You shall not oppress [your neighbor] nor rob [him]," and all [such] oppression is the withholding of a hired laborer's wages.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:2:1.hebrew: לא תגנובו דכתב רחמנא למה לי - לילף מרבית ואונאה, שהרי מחסרו ממון. לא תגנוב דעשרת הדברות לא קמיבעיא ליה, דאזהרה לגונב נפשות הוא, כדאמרינן בסנהדרין (דף פו.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:2:1.english: Why do I [need] “You shall not steal” that the Merciful One wrote - Let it be derived from interest and overcharging, for [there too] he diminishes his money. He does not ask [about] “You shall not steal” of the Ten Commandments, for it is a warning against kidnapping, as we say in Sanhedrin (86a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:2:3.hebrew: על מנת לשלם תשלומי כפל - שרוצה לההנותו, ויודע בו שלא יקבל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:2:3.english: In order to pay the double payment - For he wants to benefit him, and knows of him that he will not accept [a gift].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:3:1.hebrew: לטומן משקלותיו - המנה או הפרס טומן במלח להכבידו, וכשהוא לוקח במשקל, לוקח באלו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:3:1.english: For one who buries his weights - He buries the maneh or the peras [weight] in salt to make it heavier, and when he buys by weight, he buys with these.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:3:2.english: From the moment of the act - From the moment of burying [them], even if he has not weighed with them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:4:1.hebrew: לא ימדוד לאחד בימות החמה כו' - אחין הבאין לחלוק את השדה, לא ימדוד המודד לאחד בימות החמה ולאחד בימות הגשמים באותו החבל, מפני שהחבל לח בימות הגשמים ומתפשט כל צרכו, ובימות החמה, מתוך יובשו, הוא נגמד וכויץ:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:4:1.english: He may not measure for one during the summer, etc. - [When] brothers come to divide a field, the surveyor may not measure for one during the summer and for the other during the rainy season with the same rope, because the rope is damp during the rainy season and stretches to its full extent, whereas during the summer, due to its dryness, it shrinks and contracts.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:4:2.english: Mesurah - It is a liquid measure.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:4:3.hebrew: ירתיח - אשקומ"א בלעז, שממלא את המדה כשמוציא את היין, ולאחר זמן נמצאת חסרה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:4:3.english: [May not] froth - "Escume" in Old French [meaning foam], for he fills the measure [with foam] when he draws out the wine, and after a time it is found to be lacking.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:6:1.english: The exodus from Egypt with regard to interest - In the [Torah] portion of Behar Sinai.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:6:2.english: With regard to weights - In [the Torah portion] Kedoshim Tihyu.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:7:1.hebrew: שהבחנתי במצרים - הרי שבאו עשרה רווקים על מצרית אחת, ונתעברה מהן בעשר עבורין עשר בכורות, שהן בכורות של אביהן. כולן מתו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:7:1.english: Who distinguished in Egypt - Behold, [if] ten unmarried men cohabited with one Egyptian woman, and she conceived from them in ten conceptions ten firstborns, who are the firstborns of their [respective] fathers, all of them died.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:7:2.english: Attributes his money to a gentile - [He] lends his money to a Jew with interest and says they belong to a gentile.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:7:3.hebrew: קלא אילן - צבע הדומה לתכלת, ורחמנא אמר (במדבר ט״ו:ל״ח) "פתיל תכלת". ותכלת דמיו יקרים, שצבוע בדם חלזון, שאינו עולה מן הים אלא אחת לשבעים שנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:7:3.english: Kala ilan - A dye that resembles tekhelet [sky-blue wool], and the Merciful One said (Numbers 15:38), "a thread of tekhelet." And tekhelet is expensive, for it is dyed with the blood of the chilazon [a sea creature], which comes up from the sea only once in seventy years.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:8:1.hebrew: סורא דפרת - סורא היושבת על נהר פרת, ואין זו סורא סתם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:8:1.english: Sura on the Euphrates - [This refers to] Sura that is situated on the Euphrates River, and this is not the ordinary Sura.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:8:2.hebrew: גבי שרצים - בויהי ביום השמיני, כי אני ה' המעלה אתכם מארץ מצרים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 61b:8:2.english: In [the context of] creeping animals - In [the Torah portion] Vayehi Bayom HaShemini [Shemini, it states]: "For I am the Lord Who brings you up from the land of Egypt" [Leviticus 11:45].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:14:1.hebrew: יכין רשע וילבש צדיק - אפי' למ"ד רשות יורש לאו כרשות לוקח, וליכא שנוי רשות, ואפי' הניח קרקעות, ומלוה על פה גובה מן היורשין — אפ"ה "ילבש צדיק", כדאמר רבא בריש הגוזל בתרא (ב"ק ד' קיב.): "וחי אחיך" — לדידיה אזהר רחמנא דנהדר, לבריה לא אזהר רחמנא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:14:1.english: The wicked may prepare and the righteous shall don - Even according to the one who says [that] the domain of an heir is not like the domain of a purchaser, and [thus] there is no change of domain, and even if [the father] left real property, and a verbal loan is collected from the heirs — even so, "the righteous shall don [it]," as Rava said at the beginning of [the chapter] HaGozel Batra (Bava Kamma 112a): "[And] your brother shall live [with you]" — [only] to him [the father] did the Merciful One issue the warning to return [the interest], [but] to his son the Merciful One did not issue the warning:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:18:1.hebrew: רבא אמר מגופיה דקרא - אע"ג דרבא משני ריש הגוזל בתרא (שם): "אפילו תימא רשות יורש לאו כרשות לוקח, ושאני הכא דכתיב 'וחי אחיך עמך'", לאו משום דס"ל כר' אלעזר, דהא הכא דריש כרבי יוחנן; אלא לא בא אלא ליישב הברייתא דהתם למ"ד לאו כרשות לוקח. ולכך בסמוך, דקאמר רב נחמן "מ"ט דר"א", לא קבעו הגמרא כמו כן בשם רבא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:18:1.english: Rava said: [It can be derived] from the verse itself - Even though Rava answers at the beginning of [the chapter] HaGozel Batra (there [Bava Kamma 112a]): "Even if you say [that] the domain of an heir is not like the domain of a buyer, it is different here [regarding interest], as it is written: 'And your brother shall live with you'" — [this is] not because he holds like Rabbi Elazar, for here he expounds [the verse] in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan; rather, he only came to reconcile the baraita there according to the one who says [that the domain of an heir] is not like the domain of a buyer. And therefore, immediately below, where Rav Naḥman says, "What is the reason of Rabbi Elazar?", the Gemara did not establish it in the name of Rava as well.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:18:2.hebrew: מות יומת דמיו בו יהיה הוקשו מלוי ברבית לשופכי דמים - תימה: היכי משמע "דמיו בו" עבירה דשפיכות דמים? הלא באוב וידעוני וכמה עבירות דלא שייכי לשפיכות דמים כתיב "דמיהם בם"! וי"ל, דמיתורא ד"דמיו בו" דריש, דאי לאו הכי למאי כתביה? דאי למגמר סקילה ברבית מאוב וידעוני — חדא, דברי תורה מדברי קבלה לא ילפינן; ותו, לא מצינו מיתה גבי ממון. ובפרק קמא דתמורה (ד' ו:) יש בספרים: "וכתב בתריה והוליד בן פריץ שופך דם" — לפי זה אתי שפיר דהוקשו בהדיא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:18:2.english: "He shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him" — lenders on interest were juxtaposed with shedders of blood - This is puzzling: how does "his blood shall be upon him" imply the sin of bloodshed? Behold, regarding [a necromancer via] ov or yid'oni, and several [other] transgressions that are not related to bloodshed, it is written, "their blood shall be upon them"! And one can answer that [Rava] derives [this] from the superfluity of "his blood shall be upon him," for if not so, why was it written? For if [it were written] to derive [the punishment of] stoning for [lending on] interest from ov and yid'oni — first, we do not derive words of Torah from words of the Prophets; and furthermore, we do not find [the] death [penalty] regarding monetary [matters]. And in the first chapter of Temurah (6b), there are texts [that read]: "And it is written after it: 'And he begets a lawless son, a shedder of blood'" — according to this, it works out well, for they are explicitly juxtaposed.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:7:1.hebrew: שתולה מעותיו בנכרי - וא"ת: והלא אפילו יהא אמת שהם של נכרי אסור, כיון שאין ללוה עם הנכרי כלום? ומיהו לפי מה שנביא ראיה לקמן — ישראל שיש בידו מעות נכרי והם באחריות הנכרי מותר להלותם ברבית לישראל — אתי שפיר. אי נמי, י"ל דאיירי כגון שאמר ליה חבירו: "הלויני מעות מן הנכרי, ואמור לו שיסמוך עלי", או כגון שנתן לו משכנותיו ליתנם לנכרי, והוא הלוה לו משל עצמו ואומר שעשה כדבריו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:7:1.english: One who attributes his money to a gentile - And if you say: Is it not forbidden even if it were true that they belong to a gentile, since the borrower has nothing [to do] with the gentile? However, according to what we will bring as a proof later on — [that] a Jew who has a gentile's money in his possession and it is under the gentile's responsibility is permitted to lend it with interest to a Jew — it works out well. Alternatively, one can say that it is speaking of a case where his fellow said to him, "Borrow money for me from the gentile, and tell him to rely on me," or a case where he gave him his pledges to give to the gentile, and he [instead] lent him from his own [money] and says that he acted according to his words.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:7:2.hebrew: שתולה קלא אילן בבגדו ואומר תכלת הוא - ואע"ג דעובר על מצות ציצית, מ"מ איצטריך קרא לעבור עליו משעת תלייה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 61b:7:2.english: [One] who hangs kala ilan on his garment and says, "It is techelet" - Even though he transgresses the commandment of tzitzit, nevertheless a verse is needed [to teach] that he transgresses it from the time of hanging [it].
